subject: general
question: Which of the following has NOT been a positive impact of the Green Revolution in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Non-food grains excluded**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Green Revolution significantly increased India's food grain production.
 
• It introduced high-yielding varieties of seeds and improved irrigation techniques.
 
• While it benefitted farmers, led to industrial growth, and reduced food grain imports, it also had some negative impacts.
 
• Non-food grains were largely excluded from the benefits, leading to a lack of diversity in crops.
